{{Top|leg}}
The '''Machinists of Nikato''' were a faction around the [[Third Alsakan Conflict]] in [[14,300 BBY]]. They [[Battle of Raxus Prime (Third Alsakan Conflict)|defeated]] the [[Duros Red Credit Brigade]] and established the [[Nikato's Bootheel]] on the planet [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]. They constructed a network of elaborate clockwork mechanisms around the ancient [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] structures and helped developed the planet into a manufacturing center within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
